description: Pull observations from a UNICEF dataset. `key` is a dot-separated SDMX dimension filter, one position per dimension in the order given by dataflow_structure; leave a position empty to wildcard it. Call dataflow_structure first to learn the dimension order and valid codes. Example: get_data({ dataflow_id: "CME", key: ".CME_MRY0T4.." }) filters by INDICATOR=CME_MRY0T4 (under-five mortality rate) and wildcards REF_AREA/SEX/WEALTH_QUINTILE. Omit `key` (or pass "") to fetch all series — can be large. Returns decoded series with their dimension labels and per-period values.

dataflow_id.description: UNICEF dataflow id, e.g. "CME". The agency,flow,version reference is built automatically.

key.description: Dot-separated dimension filter (one position per dimension, empty = wildcard), e.g. ".CME_MRY0T4..". Omit for all series.

last_n.description: Return only the last N observations per series.

max_series.description: Cap the number of decoded series returned (default 200).

name: get_data
title: Get Data
